meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按这套指南排查容器化 agent 的故障：查主机日志、会话数据库（inbound.db / outbound.db）、挂载配置和心跳文件，定位容器退出、消息丢失、认证失败等问题。
howto.when: 当容器失败、消息没回复、出现认证问题时，或你想弄清容器系统如何运作时触发；它会先看 logs/nanoclaw.error.log 和会话 DB。

say.text: 帮我看下日志，机器人不回复了是什么原因
查一下这个会话的 inbound.db 有没有收到消息
say.note: 用 scripts/q.ts 查 messages_in 表

say.text: 容器退出后没写回复，帮我排查
say.note: 会查 processing_ack 和容器 stderr

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude follows this guide to debug containerized agent issues: it checks host logs, session DBs (inbound.db/outbound.db), mounts and heartbeat files to trace container exits, lost messages and auth failures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when containers fail, messages get no reply, or authentication problems appear, or when you want to understand how the container system works; it checks logs/nanoclaw.error.log and session DBs first.

say_en.text: Check the logs — my bot stopped replying
Did this session's inbound.db receive the message?
The container exited and wrote no reply — debug it
